summary: Read from 1 to 200 strings. Each string has length from 0 through 200 and holds only lowercase English letters. Find the longest opening fragment that every string owns, where ownership means the start of each string matches that fragment character by character. Write the fragment. If the strings own no opening character in common, write an empty result.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count followed by that many strings.
